department: Cognitive and Behavioural Neuroscience, School of Psychological Sciences

deadline.value: The PhD rounds are 1 March, 1 July and 1 November, but the official page gives no year, so no 2027 deadline is recorded.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is stated on the School's PhD pages checked.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact potential supervisors before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are encouraged to make contact with potential supervisors before they submit their application.

funding.value: Wellington Doctoral Scholarships are awarded competitively and availability is limited; the application is part of the PhD application.
funding.quote: Scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis and availability is limited.

entry_route.value: Entry is for applicants with an Honours degree or equivalent and/or a Masters degree in psychology.
entry_route.quote: have an Honours degree (or equivalent) and/or been awarded a Masters degree in psychology

notes: Cognitive and Behavioural Neuroscience is listed with a PhD on the School of Psychological Sciences postgraduate page. The School says international students may need the University's English requirements. No department fee, GRE or English override.
